title: Live Repository vs Historical Claim Inventory Reconciliation

details: The historical count of 412 modules originated in early SEC-005 artifacts without programmatic verification.
A shallow scan of depth <= 1 yields 42 root modules, depth <= 2 yields 1,507 modules. Neither matches 412.
The fem directory alone contains 418 modules, and cfd3d contains 495 modules.
The live file system contains 4,489 TypeScript modules across 145 subdirectories in src/engine.
Conclusion: The 412 number was a speculative placeholder that was erroneously perpetuated across reports as verified without executing an automated directory walk.
